defects: Gold uses the named function `σ (k - 1) n` (ArithmeticFunction.sigma) cast to ℂ, i.e. `((σ (k-1) n : ℕ) : ℂ)`; the produced statement instead inlines an explicit sum `∑ d in Nat.divisors n, (d : ℂ) ^ (k - 1)` with the ℕ→ℂ cast pushed inside the sum/power. These are provably equal (via Nat.cast_sum / Nat.cast_pow, i.e. push_cast) but are not syntactically/definitionally the same expression, so it is a rewritten-but-equivalent formula rather than a mere notational variant of the same structure.
